pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + glowstone dust. Starts in Wait with its light on.
Light has the same strength as a torch and follows the slime without spending stamina. Toggle Light in management independently of Follow and Wait. Existing blocks and fluids are preserved.

Right-click to spend 10 stamina on fireflies in nearby open air for six seconds, with a one-second interval. The temporary light cannot be collected and does not block building. Overlapping lights stay on while any companion or firefly effect still lights that spot.
